description: The Mongolian National Agency for Meteorology and Environmental Monitoring publishes weather, water and environment information on weather.gov.mn. The site offers forecasts for Mongolia and for world cities, forecasts for herders and farmers, environmental monitoring news, river information, observation reviews of weather and climate, an archive database, a carbon market section, today's forecast, cloud and radar images, current weather, hazardous phenomena, drought degree, pasture condition and air quality. Forecast products include three-hourly forecasts for three days, five-day forecasts by settlement and by region, monthly forecasts by settlement, ten-day, monthly and seasonal outlooks, and an option to get forecasts as XML, and the menu lists an early warning system for weather, an air quality service system and a satellite products service system. Access is free and public; no licence is stated on the page read. Caveats: the site is in Mongolian, and much of the page loads by script, so the extent of the archive is not shown. Coverage is Mongolia. It supports hazard exposure and emergency response analysis for harsh winters, drought, floods and storms affecting roads, power lines and herding communities; related records are the NEA Georgia hydrometeorological data services and the CENAOS station map of Honduras.
